design: Frozen before any Phase 3A-F timing. Synthetic pixels use seed 0x3AF0BEEF and 22 classes that are not the Phase 3A, RC, or 3A-D generators. Each class is encoded at 1920x1080 in low, medium and filmscan3, and at 3840x2160 in medium and filmscan3. Even class indexes also get 1920 high and filmscan1. Odd class indexes also get 1920 filmscan2. Six smooth or sparse classes are also attempted at 7680x4320 in low and medium. Photographs come from photos.tsv: two 1920 qualities cycled across low, medium, high, filmscan1, filmscan2 and filmscan3, plus a 3840 filmscan3 or medium encode for up to the first eight sources whose original is at least 3200x1800. Native frames are CFHDsample422.AVI frames 0, 3, 6, 12, 18 and 23. Frames 0, 12 and 23 are marked previously_timed and are not part of the untouched gate. No case is dropped because of its Auto label. Samples above 32 MiB stay in the manifest and are unsupported.
classifier: ClassifyDecodeFrame Phase 3A integer rule, not modified
